svg.title: The ECB concentration statistic against the current coefficient of variation
svg.desc: The statistic of the ECB Herfindahl index test as a function of the current CV, for 10 and 26 grades and several initial CVs; it rises, peaks and falls, and for an initial CV of 0.6 with ten grades it never reaches the 5% critical value 1.645.
svg.text: ECB HHI test statistic S against the current CV
each curve starts at its initial CV (S = 0)
